modeling_notes: A real-world party, contextual role, ownership/control situation, financial instrument, and source claim are distinct identities.
Shareholding is a FinancialAsset; Ownership is a Situation. A temporal ownership observation is evidence about them, not automatically either OWL class.
hasShareholder/holdsSharesIn connect Issuer and Shareholder roles. Use isPlayedBy to connect roles to legal entities or persons.
hasBorrower/hasLender target Borrower/Lender roles. Connect their actors by isPlayedBy and their loan context by isRoleIn.
CorporateAction is in a Release ontology; CashDividendAction and StockSplit are in a Provisional ontology and must retain that maturity.
isDomiciledIn targets a GeopoliticalEntity; isRecognizedIn targets a Jurisdiction. Country and jurisdiction are not automatically interchangeable.
Use source-scoped claims and explicit conflict/retraction handling for different provider observations; OWL vocabulary alone does not define data-quality precedence or truth selection.
Do not infer legal control solely from equity percentage. Any percentage threshold in the demo is a named, separately testable local scenario rule.
MonetaryAmount, InterestRate and ExplicitDate are structured ontology objects, not an assertion that a scalar field implements every inherited restriction.
Identifier hasTag stores its string value; identifies links identifier to its referent; synthetic demo identifiers should be explicitly marked.
A mapped property IRI documents intended semantics. Full OWL consistency/classification has not been executed by this loader.
